content_zh:
手上的军弓也似乎变轻了，这是身体力量提升所带来的错觉。
顾青山满意的点点头，看了一眼操作界面上方的沙漏。
沙漏中的沙流空了。
紧接着，一行小字迅速出现在操作界面正中央。
“玩家顾青山已在异世界停留24小时，即将返回真实世界。”
“所有装备存入储物袋，需要时可再次取出。”
“开始回归。”
一阵轻微的眩晕。
顾青山睁开眼，发现脚下是柔软的名贵毛毯，自己正单膝跪地，面向着前方的美丽女孩。
礼堂内布置的相当奢华，一如上流社会的交际场所。
唯一不和谐的是，悠扬舒缓的舞曲中，夹杂着嘈杂的、哄闹的喝彩鼓劲声。
“答应他。”
“小子，你快说啊！”
一道道声音接连不断响起。
顾青山环顾四周，视线最终停留在对面女孩的身上。
她果然是穿什么都好看，哪怕是什么首饰都不戴，仅穿着一件素白的长裙，都能让人从众多女孩之中一眼就看到她。
苏雪儿。
一个曾经刻在记忆深处，永远都没有忘记的名字。
顾青山闭上眼睛，再次睁开。
女孩儿的眼中有些一些关心和焦虑，更多的是无措。

顾青山不动声色，飞快打量四周。
熟悉的场景，记忆中的那一幕还未发生。
——原来自己真的穿越回来了啊。
这是自己一生命运的转折点。
忽然有人狠狠拍着他的肩膀，打气说：“青山，加油，勇敢说出心底的话！”
顾青山转过视线，望向那人。
张野，高中好友。
“苏雪儿，顾青山有话对你讲！”
“是啊，他精心准备了许久，想对你说出心里话。”
“顾青山，你说吧，我们都在做见证。”
人群中，又有人不断起哄。
眼见顾青山依旧沉默不语，苏雪儿终于开口了。
“顾青山，我看你并不像有什么要跟我说，是不是别人起哄作弄你，你才上来的？”
她一开口，所有人安静了下来。
大家都想看一看，顾青山是否如传言的那样，要在今天的毕业舞会上说出求爱的话。
顾青山认真听着对方的话，微微一笑。
女孩儿还是一如既然的聪明和体贴，连下台阶的借口都已经替他好好。
可惜上一世，自己还是中了别人的招。
顾青山站起身，拍拍膝盖上的灰。
“其实是这样的，我诚挚的希望你能答应我一件事。”他淡淡的道。

“什么事？”
女孩骤然紧张起来。
他今天怎么了？连自己的话都听不出来了？
顾青山正色道：“明晚来我的烧烤摊吧，尝尝我的手艺。”
苏雪儿怔住。
起哄的几人呆了呆。
围观的人群都傻了眼。
“烧烤？只是吃饭吗？没有其他的事情？”苏雪儿眼睛亮了起来。
“当然。”顾青山道。
苏雪儿睁大漂亮的眼睛，在人群中望了望，道：“可你的好朋友张野说，你要对我——”
顾青山打断她的话：“我从没跟他说过什么。”
苏雪儿就明白过来。
“是吗？原来这一切不是你的意思啊。”
她似乎松了口气，脸上也带了笑意。
张野眼见不对，急声道：“青山，你不是跟我说过，今天要跟苏雪儿表白吗？”
群情哗然。
顾青山转过头，冷冷的看了对方一眼。
张野与自己一样，都是贫民出生，凭借出色的成绩考入这所顶尖高中。
高中三年，两人结下了深厚的友谊。
顾青山原本以为，对方是他贴心贴肉的好兄弟。

谁知道，在今天的毕业舞会上，张野把一种药下在他的酒中。
结果他在对苏雪儿表白的过程中，药效发作，当众就要对苏雪儿做出下流无耻的行径。
最后还是苏雪儿的护卫，和一群学生会的干部一起，将顾青山死死按住。
这件事震动了整个学校。
原本顾青山成绩不错，颇为有才华，性格也和善，这才入了苏雪儿的眼。
这件事发生后，苏雪儿对他彻底失望，当众扇了他一个耳光，哭着离去。
苏家借此震怒，扬言要顾青山的命。
学校也毫不犹豫的开除了他，连高考的机会都没有留给他。
最后还是苏雪儿在家族中苦苦哀求了三天，苏家家主这才饶过了顾青山一条小命。
苏家家主便是掌管整个长宁郡的府主，而整个联邦，一共才九位府主。
从那以后，顾青山饱受冷眼嘲笑，没有任何人看得起他。
原本已在兼职的科技研发公司，直接辞退了他。

content_en:
The military bow in his hand also seemed to become lighter. This was an illusion brought about by the increase in physical strength.
Gu Qingshan nodded with satisfaction and glanced at the hourglass above the operation interface.
The sand in the hourglass empties.
Immediately afterwards, a line of small words quickly appeared in the center of the operation interface.
"The player Gu Qingshan has stayed in another world for 24 hours and is about to return to the real world."
“All equipment is stored in a storage bag and can be taken out again when needed.”
"Start coming back."
A slight dizziness.
Gu Qingshan opened his eyes and found that there was a soft expensive blanket under his feet. He was kneeling on one knee, facing the beautiful girl in front of him.
The interior of the auditorium was quite luxuriously decorated, just like a social gathering place for the upper class.
The only discordant thing is that the melodious and soothing dance music is mixed with noisy and noisy cheers and encouragement.
"Promise him."
"Boy, tell me quickly!"
Voices sounded one after another.
Gu Qingshan looked around, and finally his eyes rested on the girl opposite.
She really looks good in anything she wears. Even if she doesn't wear any jewelry and only wears a plain white dress, people can spot her at a glance among the many girls.
Su Xueer.
A name that has been engraved deep in my memory and will never be forgotten.
Gu Qingshan closed his eyes and opened them again.
There was some concern and anxiety in the girl's eyes, but more of she was helpless.
Gu Qingshan remained calm and quickly looked around.
The familiar scene, the scene in my memory has not happened yet.
——It turns out that I really traveled back in time.
This is the turning point of my life's destiny.
Suddenly, someone patted him hard on the shoulder and encouraged him: "Qingshan, come on, be brave and speak out what is in your heart!"
Gu Qingshan turned his gaze and looked at that person.
Zhang Ye, a high school friend.
"Su Xue'er, Gu Qingshan has something to tell you!"
"Yes, he has been carefully preparing for a long time and wants to tell you what is in his heart."
"Gu Qingshan, tell me, we are all bearing witness."
In the crowd, some people continued to boo.
Seeing that Gu Qingshan remained silent, Su Xueer finally spoke.
"Gu Qingshan, I don't think you have anything to say to me. Did you come here because someone else was teasing you?"
As soon as she spoke, everyone fell silent.
Everyone wants to see if Gu Qingshan will say his words of love at today's graduation prom as rumored.
Gu Qingshan listened carefully to what the other party said and smiled slightly.
The girl is still as smart and considerate as ever, even giving him an excuse to go down the stairs.
It's a pity that in the last life, I still fell into someone else's trick.
Gu Qingshan stood up and patted the dust on his knees.
"Actually, that's the case. I sincerely hope you can promise me something." He said calmly.
"What's the matter?"
The girl suddenly became nervous.
What happened to him today? Can't you even hear your own words?
Gu Qingshan said seriously: "Come to my barbecue stall tomorrow night and try my cooking skills."
Amelia Su was stunned.
The booing people were stunned.
The onlookers were dumbfounded.
"Barbecue? Just eating? Nothing else?" Su Xueer's eyes lit up.
"Of course." Gu Qingshan said.
Su Xueer opened her beautiful eyes wide, looked at the crowd, and said, "But your good friend Zhang Ye said, you want to tell me -"
Gu Qingshan interrupted her: "I never said anything to him."
Amelia Su understood.
"Really? It turns out that none of this was what you meant."
She seemed relieved and had a smile on her face.
Zhang Ye saw something was wrong and said anxiously: "Qingshan, didn't you tell me that you wanted to confess to Amelia Su today?"
The crowd was in an uproar.
Gu Qingshan turned his head and gave the other party a cold look.
Zhang Ye, like himself, was born in poverty and was admitted to this top high school with excellent results.
During three years of high school, the two formed a deep friendship.
Gu QingshanHe originally thought that the other party was his caring and caring brother.
Who knows, at today's graduation prom, Zhang Ye put a drug into his wine.
As a result, while he was confessing his love to Su Xueer, the drug took effect, and he was about to commit an obscene and shameless act towards Su Xueer in public.
In the end, it was Su Xueer's guards, together with a group of student union cadres, who held Gu Qingshan down.
This incident shocked the entire school.
Originally, Gu Qingshan had good grades, was quite talented, and had a kind personality, so he caught Su Xueer's eye.
After this incident, Su Xueer was completely disappointed with him, slapped him in the face in public, and left crying.
The Su family was furious and threatened to kill Gu Qingshan.
The school expelled him without hesitation and did not even leave him a chance to take the college entrance examination.
In the end, Su Xueer begged the family for three days, and then the head of the Su family spared Gu Qingshan's life.
The head of the Su family is the master in charge of the entire Changning County, and there are only nine palace masters in the entire federation.
Since then, Gu Qingshan has been ridiculed and no one thinks highly of him.
The technology research and development company where he was already working part-time fired him directly.
